serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: PC Matic Federal provides essential security that satisfies NIST 800-53 CM-7 (5) Least Functionality and fills other potential gaps left by traditional endpoint security software. With a foundation in application whitelisting, PC Matic uses a default-deny approach that prevents all known bad and untrusted applications from executing - delivered via a single lightweight agent which is downloaded from the application web portal by the agency administrator and deployed to each endpoint. Our patented globally automated whitelist technology provides a backbone of millions of known good applications to remove the headaches that come with traditional application whitelisting solutions by drastically reducing false positives during and after implementation. PC Matic Federal is hosted on the FedRAMP Authorized Hybrid ORockCloud and is operated by employees that are all U.S. citizens working for a U.S.-based company. PC Matic has partnered with NIST on implementing a Zero Trust Architecture using application whitelisting as required by the recent executive order on improving cybersecurity.
